Subject: Re: Confirming your self-serve signup and next steps — quick fit call?

Hi Samantha —

Congrats on signing up, and welcome! I’m on the SDR team and happy to set up a focused session so we can:
- Understand your primary use case and constraints
- Walk a 30–45 minute demo tailored to traffic and latency expectations
- Share recommended serving profiles and a rough cost estimate for a pilot

Before I lock time, quick questions that help our Solutions Eng prep:
1) Primary use case (one sentence): e.g., support deflection via RAG, summarization, search-based chat
2) Expected monthly active queries / tokens (ballpark)
3) Peak concurrency or QPS (any known peaks?)
4) Timeline: when would you like a pilot live (month/quarter)?
5) Any compliance/residency requirements (EU data, private VPC, etc.) or SSO/SCIM needs?

If you’d prefer, pick a 30–45m slot here and I’ll include Laura (solutions engineer): https://calendly.com/redwood/karthik-30m

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@theta-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-19T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Re: Confirming your self-serve signup and next steps — quick fit call?

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick note. Brief answers below to help your prep:
1) Use case: RAG-powered support triage + short answer extraction for our knowledge base (primary); secondary is customer-facing chat for a small beta.
2) Expected monthly queries: ~600,000 queries/month (mix of short prompts + retrieval context).
3) Peak concurrency: we see bursts up to ~200–300 QPS for short windows (nightly batch jobs and peak support hours).
4) Timeline: aim to run a 6–8 week pilot starting in late Jan 2027, production evaluation in Q2 2027.
5) Compliance: US-based data for pilot; may need EU residency for later phases. We’ll need SSO (Okta) for team access.

I attached a quick traffic snapshot for last 30 days. We’d like a 45-minute session so Laura can see our traffic profile and suggest configs. Our team (I'll loop Daniel if we confirm a time) is available:
- Tue 2026-12-22: 9:30–11:30 AM PST
- Wed 2026-12-23: 1:00–4:00 PM PST
- Thu 2026-12-30: 10:00–12:00 PM PST

Thanks —
Samantha Lee
Head of Product, Theta Analytics
samantha@theta-analytics.com

Attachments: theta_traffic_snapshot.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

Thanks for the detail, Samantha — this is perfect. I reviewed the snapshot and Laura flagged a couple of prep items so we can use the full 45 minutes:
- If possible, export a short sample of typical prompt + retrieval context (redact PII) — Laura will want to confirm average context size for KV cache planning.
- Confirm whether you expect hard 99th percentile latency SLOs (e.g., <250ms per token) or whether service can tolerate slightly higher latencies for lower cost.
- Any existing cost constraints for the pilot (monthly commit target)?

Proposed times (I'll have Laura join):
- Wed 2026-12-23, 1:30–2:15 PM PST (45m)
- Thu 2026-12-30, 10:30–11:15 AM PST (45m)

Ben will send a calendar invite if one of those works. I also attached a draft mutual action plan so we can align deliverables if you want to move forward after the demo.

Cheers,
Karthik
